title: Learning through Internalization
abstract: arXiv:2606.20937v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study internalization processes, by which neural-network-based systems absorb an explicit computational procedure into their own weights, and how they facilitate learning. We investigate how transformers internalize the simulation of semiautomata by internalizing chain-of-thought (CoT) tokens, which classes of semiautomata are harder to internalize, and expose the flip side of internalization, that is, a progressive degradation of out-of-distribution performance. translated_abstract: 我们研究内化过程，即基于神经网络的系统将显式计算过程吸收进自身权重的过程，以及这一过程如何促进学习。我们研究了Transformer如何通过内化思维链（CoT）标记来内化半自动机的模拟，探究了哪些类别的半自动机更难被内化，并揭示了内化的另一面，即分布外性能的逐步退化。随后，我们首次对成功的内化给出了可证明的分析：对于学习奇偶性（parity）的任务，我们证明一个简化的单层Transformer首先在显式CoT监督下学会目标，然后随着CoT标记被逐步移除而内化自回归生成过程，学会直接计算奇偶性。在没有CoT监督的情况下，该任务从数据中学习在计算上是困难的。最后，我们讨论了通过内化进行学习……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文首次对神经网络的内化过程给出可证明分析：在奇偶性学习任务上，单层Transformer可先借助显式思维链（CoT）监督完成学习，再随着CoT标记逐步移除而将自回归计算内化进自身权重、实现直接计算，而该任务在无CoT监督时从数据中学习是计算上困难的，同时内化也会带来分布外性能的退化。
en_tdlr: This paper provides the first provable analysis of internalization, showing that a one-layer transformer can first learn parities with explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision and then internalize the autoregressive computation into its own weights as CoT tokens are progressively removed—a task that is computationally hard to learn from data without CoT supervision—while also revealing that internalization progressively degrades out-of-distribution performance.
